City of Tulsa Planning Commission

Special Meeting

Agenda of Meeting No. 7

Wednesday, December 2, 2026
, 1:00 p.m.

Tulsa City Council Chamber, 175 E. 2nd St., Second Level, Tulsa, OK 74103

Agenda Packet

Introduction and Notice to the Public

The City of Tulsa Planning Commission provides recommendations to the Tulsa City Council on planning, development, and zoning matters. At this meeting, the Planning Commission will review, consider, discuss, and may take action on, approve, recommend for approval, amend or modify, recommend for approval with modifications, deny, reject, recommend for denial, or defer action on any item listed on the agenda.

How to Participate

You may attend the hearing to express your opinions, or have someone appear on your behalf. If you wish to present documents or exhibits during the hearing, please submit them by 9:00 a.m. the day of the hearing. Please reference the case number and include your name and address. Meetings are video recorded, broadcast, and saved online for public review. Any comments and exhibits presented will become part of the public record of the case.

To comment, email 
planning@cityoftulsa.org
 or mail to Tulsa Planning Office, 175 E. 2nd St., Suite 480, Tulsa, OK 74103.

All written comments are public and become part of the case’s record.

All electronic devices must be silenced during the hearing. If you require special accommodations pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, please notify the Tulsa Planning Office at 918-596-7526.
